messages:
Aisha: quick heads-up — reconciling March sandbox GPU spend and seeing ~ $5.6k charged to project 'playground-eu' but labels are inconsistent. example row from BQ export: project_id=playground-eu | sku=NVIDIA_T4 | cost=612.34 | labels.owner=eng-experiments :thinking:
Ben: which billing account/export? we usually map by labels.team, not labels.owner. if owner is populated but team isn't, charges land in the central sandbox pool. can you paste the raw rows? :eyes:
Aisha: pasted two more rows below — noticed owner vs team mismatch and some rows missing both labels:
```
project_id: playground-eu | sku: NVIDIA_T4 | cost: 1024.12 | labels.owner: eng-carlos
project_id: playground-eu | sku: NVIDIA_A100 | cost: 3487.26 | labels.team: research
project_id: playground-eu | sku: NVIDIA_T4 | cost: 612.34 | labels.owner: eng-experiments
```
billing-bot: ALERT: sandbox-eu daily threshold exceeded (1,000 USD). Ticket BILL-1123 created.
Carlos: sorry — that 1k row was from my stress tests last Friday. I used owner=eng-carlos instead of team=eng-experiments. my fault. is there a backfill we can run so finance can attribute it correctly? :wave:
Dana: yes — short-term fix is to run tag-based backfill against the BQ export then re-run the allocation job. example commands we use locally:
```
# backfill owner->team mapping
./tools/chargeback/backfill --from-bq projects/redwood-billing/datasets/gcp_billing_export_v1 --project playground-eu --label owner --map owner_to_team.json
# re-run allocation
python scripts/allocate_charges.py --project playground-eu --start 2026-03-01
```
Ben: I'll kick off the backfill and then re-run allocate_charges. will also deploy a nightly check to convert owner->team to avoid drift. ETA ~12:15 UTC. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Aisha: once re-run is done can finance confirm whether we should invoice eng-experiments or keep it on the central sandbox budget? we have reserved research credits but billing prefers explicit cross-charge approvals.
Marta: finance ack — ping me after the allocation job finishes and include the post-run allocation CSV. if it maps cleanly to eng-experiments we'll approve a cross-charge to that cost center, otherwise we'll revert to central sandbox and follow up.
billing-bot: Ticket BILL-1123 updated: backfill scheduled by Ben (ETA 12:15 UTC).
Dana: i'll add a short playbook note and open a tiny PR to fail GPU infra provisioning if team label is missing (pre-commit hook + small infra check).
Carlos: will update my test scripts to include labels.team going forward. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
Aisha: thanks — tagging @Marta for final sign-off after the allocation run. once Marta confirms I'll close the ticket. :white_check_mark:
